pages.text: Pour wort into a $(item)Fermenting Vat$() and add $(l:brewing/yeast)yeast$(/l): it ferments in about a day. The vat's screen shows the temperature and whether it's right for what's inside.
Temperature comes from the biome, a step cooler out of the open sky (indoors or underground), Cold beside ice and Warm beside fire. Ales like Mild, lager Cold, white wines and cider Cool.
With Serene Seasons, winter makes a vat a step cooler and summer a step warmer, except in tropical biomes (deserts, savannas, jungles), whose seasons are wet and dry instead.
